svg.title: storyboard: twenty questions, then a draft
svg.desc: storyboard asks three rounds of questions, intake first and broad, then the frame lens, then the intent lens, each narrower than the last. From the answers it drafts keyframes.md and plays it back a chunk at a time while a person corrects it. Accepting writes the file only if keyframes check --strict passes. The spec, design, and map outputs are still to come. On the line of hand-offs, storyboard is the first hop: a conversation becomes a plan file.
